# Glosso

noun · art and literary movement

> An art collective and literary movement emphasizing oration, prosody and form in pursuit of the truest articulation of an experience, rejecting institutional and performative conventions in favor of the expressive possibilities of the individual's tongue.

Based in: Miami

Current mascot: Bizzare Frog with an odd ribbon shaped tongue.
